root_idea.summary: In the supplied evidence, خِنزِير denotes the swine and can be extended figuratively to people whose character and conduct resemble it.
root_idea.development: The attested semantic development is from the named animal to a figurative description of human morals and actions; no broader root-etymological analysis is supplied.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form خِنزِير.

senses.definition: The pig or swine as the particular animal.
senses.usage_conditions: Literal animal designation; in 5:60, this is one of the two reported interpretations of the reference to swine.

senses.definition: People whose morals and actions resemble those associated with swine, without implying a change in their physical form.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-specific figurative interpretation of the swine mentioned in 5:60; the resemblance concerns character and conduct rather than bodily shape.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to خزر; it supplies no independent lexical meaning.

cautions: The interpretation of 5:60 supports both the literal animal reference and a figurative reference to human character and conduct.
